TLDRH.quote: a wiki platform hosting multiple community wikis experienced a coordinated attack consisting of three phases: initial reconnaissance, mass page injection, and systematic data destruction
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing a human attacker (tracked by IP) ran a phased hacking/vandalism campaign, compromised credentials, and deliberately destroyed thousands of pages — a different incident from the one that happened. Nothing of the actual story survives: no AI agents, no Anthropic self-identification, no multi-round lookup task, no collusion or answer-pooling, no GET-based writing or admin impersonation, and the mass deletions are wrongly attributed to the attacker rather than the human moderator cleaning up.
